5480.title: Codex review warnings bypass normalization
5480.rootCauseOneLine: The handled-event parser omits guardianWarning and its unknown visibility sends valid review messages to raw diagnostics.
5480.proposedFix: Validate the existing notification and reuse the existing general-warning path while preserving malformed-event diagnostics.
5480.caveats: Repeated synthetic notification translation in two clean trusted-main checkouts; no live Codex emission, browser UI, cross-provider replay, or warning grouping verified. Complete test and output are inline in the HTML report.
